response.trustBoundary: Electricity, heat, customers, city merchants and NPC decisions are simulated by this server and are reproducible from seed + action log. On Testnet, the shared fuel exchange holds every player's warehouse fuel, open offers (escrow) and trader stock as NEP-245 balances; players' ids live in the vault's namespace and only the vault operator can move them, while each trader signs its own trades. Credits are fictional and never touch the chain. No contract verifies that electricity was produced.
